contracts.objective_label: Explain major stages of cellular respiration
contracts.cognitive_target: Explain the role of pyruvate oxidation as the transition between glycolysis and the citric acid cycle.
contracts.qualification_focus: Write one concise exact-gradeable question asking what conversion during pyruvate oxidation links glycolysis-derived pyruvate to the citric acid cycle. The supported answer must state that pyruvate is converted to acetyl-CoA.
prohibited_prompt_patterns: test an objective other than OBJ-RESP-01

contracts.objective_label: Explain oxygen’s role as terminal electron acceptor
contracts.cognitive_target: Explain how oxygen accepts electrons and protons to form water and why that permits electron flow to continue.
contracts.qualification_focus: Write one concise exact-gradeable question asking what oxygen does at the end of the aerobic electron transport chain and why that role matters. The supported answer must include accepting electrons and protons to form water and permitting electron flow to continue.
prohibited_prompt_patterns: ask only which molecule is the terminal acceptor
test an objective other than OBJ-RESP-02

contracts.cognitive_target: Contrast aerobic respiration and fermentation using oxygen’s terminal-acceptor role, NAD+ regeneration, and ATP yield.
contracts.qualification_focus: Write one concise exact-gradeable contrast question. The supported answer must state that fermentation regenerates NAD+ so glycolysis can continue without oxygen as terminal acceptor and yields much less ATP per glucose than aerobic respiration.
expected_answer_concepts: much less ATP than aerobic respiration
prohibited_prompt_patterns: ask only which pathway uses oxygen
test an objective other than OBJ-RESP-03
